card.name: W of Warnings in cross-references
card.fires_on: The letter W that begins the word Warnings inside a bracketed label cross-reference such as "[see Warnings and Precautions (5.", usually at the end of a sentence in a drug label.

modes.label: Cross-reference to Warnings
modes.description: The W is split off from "arnings" right after "[see" and before "and Precautions".

card.plain: It fires on the first letter of "Warnings" in the bracketed "[see Warnings and Precautions" pointers at the end of label sentences.
